verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party webhook docs describe registering an HTTPS endpoint to which Stripe pushes real-time events, and Terminal runs on the same Stripe API (API-based integration, payments managed alongside online payments in Stripe). However, nothing in the pack shows Terminal-specific events (reader or payment-collection events) being delivered via webhooks. missing for 10: evidence of Terminal-specific webhook event types, documentation tying webhooks to Terminal integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
